component.name: Encore
component.summary: Listen to YouTube Music on the desktop

description.p: Encore is a desktop player for YouTube Music. It searches and plays the catalog, shows your library, playlists and mixes once you sign in, and adds what a desktop player should have: synced lyrics you can scroll and click, romanized lyrics for Japanese, Korean and Chinese, an equalizer, crossfade, skipping silence, a true random shuffle, the music video beside the lyrics, a mini player, Discord status, Last.fm scrobbling and listening together.
Encore is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google or YouTube.

The full screen view with the visualizer

description.p: The artists' names under the song playing open their page. A downloaded playlist that changed on YouTube Music offers Update, which deletes the songs taken out and downloads the new ones.
A song that cannot be played (gone from YouTube) gives way to the next one instead of leaving the player stuck; after three in a row Encore stops and says why.

Encore looks for a new version when it starts and offers to install it: it downloads the package for your system, checks it and installs it, then restarts. Settings, About turns the check off or runs it now.
Encore keeps the Google sign-in and, when YouTube drops the session, signs in again by itself with no window. It only asks for the password when Google wants it.
What the session does is written to session.log in the cache.
Keyboard shortcuts: the up and down arrows turn the volume, left and right go back or forward five seconds, and Space plays or pauses.
Encore stays in the desktop's media controls (MPRIS) even when another program asks for its name.
The order drop-down of song lists looks like Encore's other buttons.
Playlists, albums and the library's song lists can be searched and ordered by title, artist, album or duration.

A right click on a song opens its menu: play next, add to the queue, start a radio, add to or remove from a playlist, the queue or the downloads, go to its artist or album, like, dislike and copy its link.
The cover of the song playing is sharp on the now playing page.
The forward arrow works, Back remembers every screen, and the sidebar highlights the screen shown.
Controls that did nothing are gone or disabled while nothing plays.
Downloads go on after Encore restarts, download whole playlists, wait in line and show in Downloads while they run.
The downloads folder can be chosen in Settings, Audio.
An Arch Linux package comes with each release.
Encore runs on Windows, with an installer that includes everything it needs.
Play starts a song again if it never started instead of doing nothing.
The first release.
